text:
Maya: Cutting RC candidate rc-2026.03-15 from branch release/feature/hotfix-embed-cache at commit 3f8a9b. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-rcs/rc-2026.03-15.tar.gz

deploy-bot: [rc:create] rc-2026.03-15 created by @Maya. Artifact: 3f8a9b. Canaries configured: us-west2=2 pods, eu-west1=2 pods. Change window requested: 2026-03-15 22:00-23:00 UTC.

Sam: Quick checklist: smoke passed on build VM? load test snapshot available?

Maya: Smoke on build VM: green. Quick load snapshot (10m) shows no token errors. Logs attached from smoke run.

Anita: Ran QA smoke suite against canary image. Results: 28/30 tests passed. Failures look like flaky metric exporter timeouts (non-blocking). Re-runs in progress.

Anita: failing test snippet:
```
test_metrics_exporter_timeout (tests/e2e/metrics_test.py) - timeout at 5s
last logs: ConnectionTimeout to metrics-svc:443
```

Kai: Feature flag plan: enable embed_kv_cache=true for canary traffic only. No schema changes. Devex will update changelog and example config.

Leon: Need PM confirm release notes blurb and infra sign-off for pinning. Also call out rollback criteria clearly in the thread.

Maya: Proposed rollback criteria:
- error_rate >= 1.0% sustained for 5m OR
- p95 latency increase > 150ms vs baseline for 5m OR
- CPU saturations causing OOMs on any host.
Auto-rollback enabled for first 30m of promotion unless manually overridden by @Sam or @Maya.

ops-bot: monitors configured: error_rate_threshold=1.0%, p95_latency_threshold=250ms. Auto-rollback=enabled (grace_period=300s). Alerting: page @Sam if threshold breached.

Sam: I'm on-call during the window, will watch metrics and logs. If canary stays within thresholds for 15m, I approve expanding to 25%.

Anita: Re-ran flaky tests, all green now. QA gives +1 for promotion.

Leon: Release notes draft: "Fix: embed cache eviction bug; Reduced tokenization latency for long prompts; Hotfix rollout via canary with feature flag embed_kv_cache."

Maya: Final sign-off summary: QA +1, SRE (Sam) watching +1, PM (Leon) +1. If no objections by 21:30 UTC we'll schedule promotion at 22:10 UTC and pin the artifact for production. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [rc:promote-schedule] rc-2026.03-15 -> prod scheduled at 2026-03-15T22:10:00Z. Rollout policy: canary 5% (15m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100%. Feature flag embed_kv_cache=true for canary traffic only.

Maya: Scheduling promotion now. Requesting brief silence on unrelated infra changes in the window (avoid concurrent kernel upgrades).

deploy-bot: [rc:promote-start] Initiating promotion at 2026-03-15T22:10:00Z. Step 1: route 5% traffic to rc-2026.03-15 canaries.

deploy-bot: [metrics] canary step reached: 5% traffic. p50=35ms p95=120ms error_rate=0.12% CPU=42%

Sam: Watching metrics — looks stable for first 8m. No anomalies in logs.

deploy-bot: [metrics] 14m elapsed in 5% step; p95=128ms error_rate=0.15% -> proceed to 25%

deploy-bot: [promote] rolled to 25%. Hold for 15m. Current metrics: p95=135ms error_rate=0.18%

Sam: Still good. No action required.

deploy-bot: [promote] 25% hold complete, rolling to 100% production.

deploy-bot: [promote:done] rc-2026.03-15 promoted to prod (100%). No auto-rollback triggered.

Maya: Post-deploy checks: traces look normal, no new alerts in the last 20m. Closing RC thread. Thanks team. :party_parrot:

Leon: Noted for release notes and billing window. Great job everyone.
